description: Federal Highway Trust Fund Receipts Attributable to Highway Users by State, 1999 - 2024 (FE-9) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. Annual dollars of federal highway trust fund receipts from various tax sources for each of the 50 states and DC from the Highway Statistics table FE-9. (Note: Tax type for "Gasohol" only from 1999 to 2005.). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 5 columns, among them Account, Year, Tax, Receipts, State. The portal shows 2026-02-11 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
